$comment: The shared local-query parity oracle: the regression fixture of the one evaluator. One vector = { name, rows, plan, expected } where plan is the QueryPlan JSON kizunasync-query::apply_query accepts and expected lists the result row ids in result order. expectError marks a plan the evaluator refuses and expectCode names the engine error code it refuses it with. Consumed by the Rust runner crates/kizunasync-query/tests/parity_vectors.rs and the TypeScript runner packages/core/src/query/parity-vectors.test.ts, never duplicated.
